light.best.quote: The sun-loving amaryllis grows best indoors in a well-lighted area that receives at least four hours of direct sunlight daily.

light.min.reason: 毎日4時間以上の直射日光が必要とされるため、明るい日陰を下限とした

light.directSun.quote: A southern window exposure is best

temperature.minC.quote: Note that plants are injured at temperatures below 35 degrees F.

temperature.idealC.quote: Amaryllis prefers warm temperatures (70 to 75 °F) for best growth

humidity.reason: 出典に湿度の記載がないため「ふつう」とした

watering.growing.quote: After that, keep the soil slightly moist and empty any saucer underneath the pot.

watering.winter.quote: Amaryllis bulbs need a dormant period of recovery and rejuvenation after bloom.

tips.ja: 花が咲いたら少し涼しく（18℃前後）すると花が長持ちする。
tips.quote: Once the plant flowers, cooler temperatures (65 °F) will prolong the flower's life.

tips.ja: 数日ごとに鉢を回すと花茎がまっすぐ伸びる。
tips.quote: Rotate the pot every few days so the flower stalk will remain vertical
